payload.reason: The evidence clearly outlines the three layers of the annotation scheme used in the OLID dataset.

claims.text: The three layers of the annotation scheme are: (A) whether language is offensive or not, (B) type of offensive language, and (C) target of the offensive language.
Level B categorizes the type of offensive language, which includes categories like profanity, insult, or abuse.
Level C categorizes the targets of insults and threats as individual (IND), group (GRP), and other (OTH).
